text:
sqlpipe copies Postgres tables to S3 as Parquet files. You give it a source database and a target bucket. It reads each table, converts the rows to Parquet format, and writes the files to S3.

sqlpipe runs as a single binary with no external dependencies. It connects to Postgres through a standard connection string and authenticates to S3 with IAM credentials or environment variables. You can run it as a one-time export or schedule it with cron. Each run does a full table copy by default. If you need incremental syncs, you set a watermark column in the configuration. sqlpipe logs each step to stdout so you can monitor progress and catch errors early.
